ELESIS-COUNTERATTACK.title: Counter Attack
ELESIS-COUNTERATTACK.description: When Elesis is attacked, deal fixed, blockable damage equal to your Counter Attack back to the attacker once for each hit received. Counter Attack expires at Block cleanup.
ELESIS-BURN.title: Burn
ELESIS-BURN.description: Before a monster acts, it takes unblockable damage equal to its Burn, then loses half of its Burn, rounded up.
